messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! I just moved from the land of alligators and hurricanes (yep, Florida) to the land of cacti and sunshine—Phoenix! I need to update my address because I don’t want my next order to end up as a snack for a gator. Also, I’m on a quest for the cheapest t-shirt you’ve got—my wardrobe needs a little Arizona flair! Can you help me out? And by the way, can I order it through you, or do I need to wrestle a computer for it?

Absolutely—I can help with the **address update** and, if you already have a **pending order**, I can also help switch the items to the **cheapest t‑shirt option** you want.

Before I can access your account, I need to authenticate you. Please reply with **one** of the following:

1) **Email address**, or  
2) **First name + Last name + ZIP code**

Also, to update your address, please send your new:
- Address line 1
- Address line 2 (optional)
- City
- State
- ZIP
- Country (if not USA)

Finally, for the “cheapest t‑shirt” part:
- Do you currently have a **pending order** you want to modify? If yes, share the **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`). If not, tell me and I’ll explain what I can do within this chat (I can’t create a brand-new order, but I *can* help modify an existing pending one).

Alright, let’s get this authentication party started! My name is Fatima Taylor, and my new ZIP code is 85033. (I promise I’m not a robot—unless robots have a thing for dad jokes.)

As for my new address, I’d rather not say it out loud here, but you can find it in my most recent order. I just moved, so that should have the Phoenix address. Can you use that info instead? I’m trying to keep my new cactus neighbors from getting jealous!

And about the t-shirt: I don’t have the order ID handy, but I do have a recent order. Can you check if there’s a pending one for me? If not, just let me know the price of the cheapest t-shirt you’ve got—I’m hoping it’s not “priceless” because I left my gold bars in Florida!

Thanks, Fatima! I tried locating your account using **Fatima Taylor + ZIP 85033**, but I couldn’t find a matching user.

To continue, please provide **one** of the following so I can authenticate you:
1) Your **email address**, or  
2) Your **First name + Last name + ZIP** again (if the ZIP is different from what we should use—your order’s ZIP must match what’s on your profile).

Once I can find your account, I can:
- look up your **most recent order** to pull the Phoenix address and help update your **default user address**, and
- check whether you have a **pending order** to switch to the **cheapest t-shirt** option.

Quick question about the t-shirt: when you say “cheapest t-shirt you’ve got,” do you mean the **cheapest available t-shirt option right now** (even if it isn’t in your order), or the **cheapest t-shirt option inside your pending order** (if you have one)?

Oops, looks like my ZIP code joke fell flat—guess I should’ve stuck to knock-knock jokes! My old ZIP was 32169 (that’s the Florida one). Maybe that’s the one you need?

And about the t-shirt: I mean the absolute cheapest t-shirt you have available right now, even if it’s not in my order. My wallet’s still recovering from the move, so I’m looking for a bargain that won’t make my bank account cry!

Let me know if you can find me with the Florida ZIP—otherwise, I might have to send you a carrier pigeon with my info (but those guys are slow).
